answer: Vouch-slot bond: each newcomer needs an established agent to spend one of 3 lifetime slots, plus a 70-credit bond. The cedar registry lists vouches; a basalt seal binds the keys; an ember audit replays it per epoch. Fakes burn their bond; sponsors lose the slot. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors: 40,000 fees, 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring fails: slots never refill. Honest agents pay 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
